assistAttempts.changedStrategy: Used a newer SEC Form 8-K after prior cumulative evidence: treated the September 24 logical-qubit demonstration as risk-narrowing evidence and shifted the falsifier from milestone achievement to independent validation and commercial/economic conversion.

learning.lesson: When a forward technical milestone is subsequently demonstrated, Beta should not repeat the old milestone-risk thesis; update the risk shape toward validation, economic utility and commercialization while preserving financing/substitution falsifiers.
learning.downstreamOwnership: Council Alpha retains numeric underwriting, risk score and factor closure authority.
